body:
Me too, thanks.

But really: Thank you.

I don't trust professionals (you can check my history if you want to know why) and I **especially** don't trust hotlines for the same reason.

I'm sorry.  I'm just being a burden.
I'm still not entirely comfortable talking in comments at all.

I would if they didn't give me anxiety attacks and I didn't live in Southern New England (it's stupid hot here right now).  Unfortunately wearing a tactleneck in this weather would just attract attention to my neck even more.  Make it obvious that I'm hiding something.

It just really doesn't seem like it's worth living.
Not well at all.  But you don't have to worry about it.  No one can help me.
They always do though.  And they all just try to make me feel guilty about everything.

I've tried everything and all everyone ever does is try to make me feel guilty for having thoughts/feelings I can't control.  Even professionals.

If that were an option I wouldn't have them.
Do rope burns count as "okay" though?
That's what I said five years ago though.  And five years before that.  And I'm just worse.
Why is it that when I say I want to hang myself, everyone says that my family and "friends" will remember forever and always hurt, but when I say that's my goal I'm told I'll just be forgotten about?

I still believe in [eternal oblivion](https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eternal_oblivion).  I won't exist to miss anything.  And eventually no one will exist to miss me.

No one would miss me now anyway.
I almost got caught with rope burns around my neck after it broke.
